The OwnerOS Readiness Score

We score your business from 0 to 100 across 10 dimensions. Most businesses we assess score between 15 and 40. After working with us, clients typically reach 65–85.

0–20Highly manual and fragile
21–40Basic systems but inconsistent
41–60Some structure but many gaps
61–80Good foundation, optimization needed
81–100Strong system, ready to scale

How it works

1

You fill out the intake form

20 minutes. Tells us how your business runs, what tools you use, and where the biggest pain points are.

2

We do a 60-minute discovery call

We go deeper. Your workflow, your team structure, your current follow-up process, your tech stack.

3

We build the report

5–7 business days to produce your Readiness Score, workflow map, bottleneck report, and roadmap.

4

We present and walk you through it

30-minute walkthrough call. We explain every finding, answer your questions, and recommend next steps.

5

You decide what to do next

No pressure. The roadmap is yours. Many clients move forward with an implementation — some start with quick wins on their own.
